outs.note: Mobley was ruled out for 11/16 with a left great toe sprain. He has not played since 11/11, and Sam Merrill was also out for Cleveland. The show said Mobley's absence locks in Jarrett Allen's role.
Merrill is already ruled out for 11/16, and he has not played since 11/06. His absence keeps the wing minutes open for Meleek Thomas and the other Cleveland reserves.
Capela started on Oct. 30 with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out, but he is now out himself. He missed Nov. 2 with a right ankle sprain.

Marcus Smart has not played since 11/11 because of a league suspension, and he missed the 11/13 and 11/15 games. The show expects him to be out again on 11/16, which keeps Reed Sheppard in play as a cheap guard.

Ty Jerome sat Memphis's game on November 14 after playing 29 minutes on November 13. The show said he is ruled out for Monday, November 16, and that it had wrongly thought he sat on November 14 only because of flight delays.
Isaiah Stewart is questionable for Monday, November 16, with an illness after starting at center in both games Zach Edey missed.
The show said LeBron James is playing Sunday, November 15, after missing the November 12 game. Because the 76ers are on a back-to-back, the show guessed he probably sits Monday, November 16.
The show said Adem Bona is out for Philadelphia on Monday, November 16. He has not played since November 4.
Pelle Larsson missed Miami's game on November 14 and has not played since November 10. The show said he is questionable again for Monday, November 16, with an illness.
